answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital Sybil resistance mechanism, tethering network influence to capital lockup rather than ephemeral compute. An attacker attempting to flood an onyx cluster with fake identities faces a sable wall of economic attrition, as they must acquire and stake native tokens to gain consensus weight. Any illicit activity risks a total sonnet of slashing events, forcing the adversary to absorb massive financial losses that far exceed the utility of gaining deceptive control.
